translation: The nao bone (臑骨) is the bone below the shoulder and above the elbow. From the shoulder down to the wrist, it is also called the humerus (肱), commonly called the arm (胳膊), and is the general name for the two great branches of the upper body. Whether it is shattered by falling from a carriage or horse, or broken by a blow, or split obliquely, or severed, or broken into pieces, a blow-broken bone has broken fragments, while a fall-broken bone has no broken fragments; with congested swelling and pain, a flustered and confused mind, and cold numbness over the whole body, in all cases use manual technique, following the sinews above, below, front, and back to make them harmonious and smooth, massage and press the injured bone seams to make them level and correct, then bind small fir boards (杉板) around it, and wrap it externally with white cloth. Administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) externally. If the congested swelling does not subside, wash externally with Sanyu Heshang Tang (Dispersing Stasis and Harmonizing Injury Decoction, 散瘀和傷湯).
